![computer, ipad, and iphone with pictures from globallink](http://mohawkglobal.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/11/EXHIBITION.png)

New look, same product. International clients, get ready to experience a more modern and streamlined appearance with [GlobalLink’s recently renovated platform](https://portal.mohawkglobal.com/).

Here’s a look at some of the fresh features. Click the thumbnails to enlarge.

**Home Screen**

[![main page](http://mohawkglobal.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/11/main-page-300x209.png)](http://mohawkglobal.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/11/main-page.png)

**Shipment Dashboard**

Dig deeper into shipment details with this dashboard.

[![shipment dashboard](http://mohawkglobal.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/11/shipment-dashboard-300x115.png)](http://mohawkglobal.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/11/shipment-dashboard.png)

**Shipment View**

[![shipment view](http://mohawkglobal.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/11/shipment-view-300x69.png)](http://mohawkglobal.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/11/shipment-view.png)

**Shipment Details**

[![shipment details](http://mohawkglobal.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/11/shipment-details-300x103.png)](http://mohawkglobal.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/11/shipment-details.png)

**Location Matrix**

[![shipment details-location matrix](http://mohawkglobal.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/11/shipment-details-location-matrix-300x109.png)](http://mohawkglobal.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/11/shipment-details-location-matrix.png)

**PO Details**

[![shipment details-PO details](http://mohawkglobal.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/11/shipment-details-PO-details-300x251.png)](http://mohawkglobal.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/11/shipment-details-PO-details.png)

**Invoice Details**

[![shipment details-invoice details](http://mohawkglobal.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/11/shipment-details-invoice-details-300x107.png)](http://mohawkglobal.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/11/shipment-details-invoice-details.png)

**Container Details**

[![shipment details-more container details](http://mohawkglobal.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/11/shipment-details-more-container-details-300x126.png)](http://mohawkglobal.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/11/shipment-details-more-container-details.png)

**Entry View**

Use the entry review to mark an entry as flagged or approved.

[![entyreview](http://mohawkglobal.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/11/entyreview-300x103.png)](http://mohawkglobal.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/11/entyreview.png)

**PO Manager**

The PO Manager displays your data in graphs, which gives you a visual of your open loads and POs.

[![PO Manager Dashboard](http://mohawkglobal.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/11/PO-Manager-Dashboard-300x196.png)](http://mohawkglobal.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/11/PO-Manager-Dashboard.png)

**Standard Reports**

Standard Reports gives you the option to export your data as a report or display it on screen.

[![Standard reports](http://mohawkglobal.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/11/Standard-reports-300x104.png)](http://mohawkglobal.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/11/Standard-reports.png)

Take a look at our [GlobalLink 3.0 Help Guide](https://sway.com/Xi8NQM2vMZjvksoA) for a more detailed view of the features offered. If you’re interested in learning how to customize this further contact us at [info@mohawkglobal.com](mailto:info@mohawkglobal.com).
